summary: SVG diagram generation from structured scene descriptions or SAT question data: accepts a scene JSON body via HTTP POST or CLI invocation and returns an SVG string produced by an LLM-backed rendering pipeline. Runs as a standalone microservice on port 8001. Includes a question-oriented image generation endpoint that derives the scene from a question object, a CLI render command, and a CLI serve command.

evidence.claim: POST /render accepts a scene JSON request body and returns an SVG diagram via the generation pipeline
POST /image/fromQuestion accepts an ImageFromQuestionRequest and generates an SVG asset from question data
GET /health returns a HealthResponse JSON for liveness probing of the svg-gen microservice
svg-gen render CLI generates an SVG from a scene description using the LLM pipeline and writes to stdout or file
svg-gen serve CLI starts the FastAPI web server on port 8001 for handling POST /render requests

invariants.statement: All surfaces share the same LLM-backed rendering pipeline for scene-to-SVG conversion
The microservice runs on port 8001 by default

scenarios.name: render scene via HTTP
scenarios.when: POST /render is called on the svg-gen microservice
scenarios.then: An SVG diagram string is returned in the response

scenarios.name: generate question image
scenarios.given: A SAT math question object with relevant context
scenarios.then: An SVG image asset derived from the question content is returned

scenarios.name: render scene via CLI
scenarios.given: A scene description string or file
scenarios.when: svg-gen render is invoked on the command line
scenarios.then: An SVG is written to stdout or the specified output file
